one_line: A skilled metalworker of the Malla republic of Pava, present at the Buddha’s final journey.

appearance.age_look: early 30s, lean craftsman’s build with wiry strength
appearance.face: Oval face with medium-brown north Indian complexion, straight nose, sharp jawline, faint soot freckles on cheeks, neatly kept short beard along jaw and chin, default expression calm and attentive with a hint of earnest concern.
appearance.hair: Thick black hair cut short around the ears and nape, top slightly longer and combed back in loose waves; simple narrow white cotton headband tied at the back to keep hair off his face while working.
appearance.costume: Era-accurate 5th century BCE north Indian artisan attire: an undyed off-white knee-length cotton tunic with short sleeves and a simple round neck, belted at the waist with a brown leather thong; over this, a light saffron-brown cotton uttariya (shawl) draped from left shoulder across chest and around back, leaving both arms free; straight, ankle-length cotton trousers in muted indigo, slightly tapered and tied with a drawstring; plain brown leather sandals with toe loop and ankle strap; minimal jewellery—a single small copper bangle on the right wrist and a simple copper ear stud in the left ear, hinting at his craft.
appearance.signature: A medium-sized iron hammer with a dark wooden handle wrapped in faded red cloth at the grip, the head slightly worn and darkened from use, carried either in his right hand or hanging through his belt on the right side.

ref_desc: Cunda of Pava is a lean early-30s north Indian metalworker with medium-brown skin, short wavy black hair held by a white headband, a neat short beard, wearing an off-white tunic, saffron-brown shawl, muted indigo trousers, brown sandals, copper bangle and ear stud, and always carrying a worn iron hammer with a red-wrapped handle.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Cunda of Pava: a lean early-30s north Indian metalworker with medium-brown complexion, oval face, straight nose, sharp jaw, faint soot freckles, and a neatly trimmed short beard; his thick black hair is cut short around the ears and nape with slightly longer waves on top, kept back by a simple narrow white cotton headband tied at the back. He wears an off-white knee-length cotton tunic with short sleeves and a round neck, belted at the waist with a brown leather thong, over straight ankle-length muted indigo cotton trousers tied with a drawstring, and a light saffron-brown cotton uttariya shawl draped from his left shoulder across the chest and around his back, arranged to leave both arms free. His feet are in plain brown leather sandals with a toe loop and ankle strap; his only ornaments are a small copper bangle on his right wrist and a simple copper ear stud in his left ear. His signature prop is a medium-sized iron hammer with a dark wooden handle wrapped in faded red cloth at the grip, the worn darkened hammerhead either held in his right hand or resting through his belt at his right hip. Use a palette of off-white, muted indigo, saffron brown, dark brown, and faded red, and show him from multiple angles to clearly present face details, headband, hairstyle, layered garments, and the hammer design.
